name: @iflow-mcp/mp-tool-komodo-mcp-server

tools.name: komodo_configure
tools.description: Configure connection to Komodo Core server. Required before using any other Komodo tools. Supports three auth methods: username+password (local login), apiKey+apiSecret, or jwtToken.

tools.name: komodo_health_check
tools.description: Check the Komodo connection status. Returns health, authentication status, and API version. Works without an active connection (reports unconfigured state).

tools.name: komodo_list_containers
tools.description: List all containers on a server, including running, stopped, and paused containers. Shows container name, state, and image.

server.description: Server ID or name to list containers from

tools.name: komodo_inspect_container
tools.description: Get detailed low-level information about a container. Returns Docker inspect data including configuration, state, network settings, mounts, and process info.

server.description: Server ID or name where the container is running

container.description: Container name or ID to inspect

tools.name: komodo_get_container_logs
tools.description: Get stdout and stderr logs from a container. Useful for debugging, monitoring application output, and troubleshooting issues.

server.description: Server ID or name where the container is running

container.description: Container name or ID to get logs from

tail.description: Number of lines to show from the end of logs. Default: 100

timestamps.description: Show timestamps in log output. Default: false

tools.name: komodo_search_logs
tools.description: Search container logs for specific patterns or keywords. Retrieves logs and filters them client-side. Returns matching lines with a count of matches.

server.description: Server ID or name where the container is running

container.description: Container name or ID to search logs from

query.description: Search query or pattern to filter logs (plain text, not regex)

tail.description: Number of lines to retrieve before filtering. Default: 1000

tools.name: komodo_prune
tools.description: Prune unused resources on a server. This permanently removes stopped containers, unused images, volumes, or networks to free up resources.

pruneTarget.description:
Type of Docker resource to prune:
- containers: Remove all stopped containers
- images: Remove unused images (dangling and unreferenced)
- volumes: Remove all unused local volumes
- networks: Remove all unused networks
- system: Run docker system prune (containers, networks, images)
- all: Prune all resource types

tools.name: komodo_start_container
tools.description: Start a stopped or paused container. The container must exist and be in a stopped or paused state.

server.description: Server ID or name where the container is running

container.description: Container name or ID to perform the action on

inputSchema.description: Identifies a container for lifecycle operations (start, stop, restart, pause, unpause)

tools.name: komodo_stop_container
tools.description: Stop a running container gracefully. Sends SIGTERM first, then SIGKILL after timeout.

server.description: Server ID or name where the container is running

container.description: Container name or ID to perform the action on

inputSchema.description: Identifies a container for lifecycle operations (start, stop, restart, pause, unpause)

tools.name: komodo_restart_container
tools.description: Restart a container. Stops the container if running, then starts it again. Useful for applying configuration changes.

server.description: Server ID or name where the container is running

container.description: Container name or ID to perform the action on

inputSchema.description: Identifies a container for lifecycle operations (start, stop, restart, pause, unpause)

tools.name: komodo_pause_container
tools.description: Pause all processes in a running container using cgroups freezer. The container remains in memory but consumes no CPU cycles.

server.description: Server ID or name where the container is running

container.description: Container name or ID to perform the action on

inputSchema.description: Identifies a container for lifecycle operations (start, stop, restart, pause, unpause)

tools.name: komodo_unpause_container
tools.description: Resume a paused container. All processes that were frozen will continue execution.

server.description: Server ID or name where the container is running

container.description: Container name or ID to perform the action on

inputSchema.description: Identifies a container for lifecycle operations (start, stop, restart, pause, unpause)

tools.name: komodo_create_stack
tools.description:
Create a new Docker Compose stack in Komodo.

REQUIRED: name
RECOMMENDED: server_id (target server)

STACK MODES:
- Compose Mode: Set server_id for single-server docker compose
- Swarm Mode: Set swarm_id to deploy as Docker Swarm stack

FILE SOURCES (choose one):
1. file_contents: Define compose YAML directly in the config
2. repo + branch: Clone from git repository
3. files_on_host: Use existing files on the server

server_id.description: Server ID or name for Compose mode deployment
Server ID or name to deploy on (required unless using swarm_id)

swarm_id.description: Swarm ID for Docker Swarm mode deployment. If both are set, swarm_id takes precedence.

auto_pull.description: Run "docker compose pull" before deploying (Compose mode only)

run_build.description: Run "docker compose build" before deploying (Compose mode only)

tools.name: komodo_create_deployment
tools.description:
Create a new Komodo deployment (Docker container).

REQUIRED: name
RECOMMENDED: server_id (target server) and image (what to deploy)

IMAGE FORMATS:
- Simple string: "nginx:latest", "ghcr.io/owner/repo:v1.0"
- Object format: { type: "Image", params: { image: "nginx:latest" } }
- Komodo Build: { type: "Build", params: { build_id: "..." } }

tools.name: komodo_server_exec
tools.description: Execute a shell command on a Komodo server via Periphery terminal. The command runs on the host machine where the Periphery agent is installed. Returns stdout/stderr output and exit code. Use for server diagnostics, file operations, or system commands.

command.description: The shell command to execute on the server

terminal.description: Terminal session name on the server. If it doesn't exist, it will be created. Default: mcp

tools.name: komodo_container_exec
tools.description: Execute a command inside a running Docker container on a server. Similar to 'docker exec'. Returns stdout/stderr output and exit code. Use for container debugging, running maintenance commands, or checking application state.

server.description: Server ID or name where the container is running

container.description: Container name or ID to perform the action on

command.description: The command to execute inside the container

shell.description: The shell to use for execution (e.g. 'sh', 'bash', '/bin/zsh'). Default: sh

tools.name: komodo_deployment_exec
tools.description: Execute a command inside the container of a Komodo deployment. Uses the deployment's associated container. Returns stdout/stderr output and exit code.

deployment.description: Deployment ID or name to execute the command in

command.description: The command to execute inside the deployment container

shell.description: The shell to use for execution (e.g. 'sh', 'bash', '/bin/zsh'). Default: sh

tools.name: komodo_stack_service_exec
tools.description: Execute a command inside a specific service container of a Komodo stack. Targets a single service within a Docker Compose stack. Returns stdout/stderr output and exit code.

service.description: The service name within the stack to execute the command in

command.description: The command to execute inside the service container

shell.description: The shell to use for execution (e.g. 'sh', 'bash', '/bin/zsh'). Default: sh

tools.name: komodo_list_api_keys
tools.description: List all API keys for the currently authenticated Komodo user. Shows key name, key ID (not secret), creation date, and expiry.

tools.name: komodo_create_api_key
tools.description: Create a new API key for the currently authenticated Komodo user. Returns the key and secret — the secret is shown only once and cannot be retrieved later. Optionally set an expiry time.

name.description: A descriptive name for the API key

expires_in_days.description: Number of days until the key expires. 0 means no expiry. Default: 0

tools.name: komodo_delete_api_key
tools.description: Delete an API key for the currently authenticated Komodo user. Requires the key ID (not the secret). Use komodo_list_api_keys to find key IDs.

key.description: The API key ID to delete (use komodo_list_api_keys to find it)
